vicuna33b: Vicuna 33B is the largest Vicuna chat model from LMSYS, fine-tuned from Meta's original LLaMA 33B on user-shared ChatGPT conversations collected from ShareGPT. phi3small: Phi-3 Small 8K Instruct is the 7B-parameter mid-size model in Microsoft's Phi-3 family of small language models, released in May 2024; this is the 8K-token context version. starlinglm7b: Starling LM 7B Beta is an open-weight 7B chat model from Nexusflow, released in March 2024. llama270b: Llama 2 70B Chat is the largest chat-tuned model in Meta's Llama 2 family, released with open weights in July 2023. starlinglm7balpha: Starling LM 7B Alpha is an open-weight 7B chat model from UC Berkeley researchers, released in November 2023. llama323b: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct is a small open-weights text model from Meta, released in September 2024 as one of the two lightweight members of the Llama 3.2 family alongside the 1B model. noushermes2mixtral8x7bdpo: Nous Hermes 2 Mixtral 8x7B DPO is an open-weights chat model from Nous Research, built on Mistral AI's Mixtral 8x7B sparse mixture-of-experts model. granite302b: Granite 3.0 2B Instruct is a small open-weights language model from IBM, the instruction-tuned 2-billion-parameter dense model in the Granite 3.0 family released in October 2024. llama270bsteerlm: Llama 2 70B SteerLM Chat is an open-weights chat model from NVIDIA, created by fine-tuning Meta's Llama 2 70B with NVIDIA's SteerLM method. solar107binstructv10: SOLAR 10.7B Instruct v1.0 is an open-weights chat model from the Korean company Upstage, released in December 2023. dolphin221mistral7b: Dolphin 2.2.1 Mistral 7B is an open-weights chat model from Cognitive Computations, Eric Hartford's open model project, fine-tuned from Mistral AI's Mistral 7B. mpt30b: MPT 30B Chat is the chat-tuned version of MPT-30B, a 30-billion-parameter open-weights decoder model released by MosaicML (now part of Databricks) in June 2023. wizardlm13b: WizardLM 13B is an open-weights instruction-following model developed by researchers at Microsoft, fine-tuned from a 13-billion-parameter Llama 2 base model. mistral7binstructv02: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.2 is an open-weights instruction-tuned model from Mistral AI, an updated release of Mistral 7B Instruct published in December 2023. falcon180b: Falcon 180B Chat is the chat-tuned version of Falcon 180B, a 180-billion-parameter open-weights model from the Technology Innovation Institute (TII) in Abu Dhabi, released in September 2023. qwen157b: Qwen1.5-7B-Chat is the 7-billion-parameter chat model in Alibaba's Qwen1.5 series, released in February 2024 as a beta version of what became Qwen2. phi3mini4kinstructjune: Phi-3 Mini 4K Instruct (June 2024) is Microsoft's mid-2024 update to Phi-3 Mini, its 3.8-billion-parameter small open-weights model, here with a 4K-token context window. vicuna13b: Vicuna 13B is an open-weights chat model from LMSYS, created by fine-tuning a 13-billion-parameter Meta Llama model on user-shared ChatGPT conversations collected from ShareGPT. llama213b: Llama 2 13B Chat is the mid-sized dialogue model in Meta's Llama 2 family, released in July 2023 alongside 7B and 70B versions. qwen14b: Qwen-14B-Chat is the chat-tuned 14-billion-parameter model in Alibaba Cloud's first-generation Qwen series, released in September 2023. gemma7bit: Gemma 7B IT is the instruction-tuned 7B model in Google's first Gemma family of open-weights models, released in February 2024. codellama34b: Code Llama 34B Instruct is a 34-billion-parameter code-specialised open-weights model from Meta, released in August 2023. zephyr7b: Zephyr 7B Beta is an open-weights chat model from Hugging Face's H4 team, the second model in the Zephyr series, fine-tuned from Mistral AI's Mistral 7B and released in October 2023. phi3mini: Phi-3 Mini 128K Instruct is a 3.8-billion-parameter open-weights model from Microsoft, released in April 2024 as the smallest member of the Phi-3 family. guanaco33b: Guanaco 33B is an open-weights chat model created by Tim Dettmers and colleagues at the University of Washington as part of the QLoRA research released in May 2023. zephyr7balpha: Zephyr 7B Alpha is the first model in Hugging Face's Zephyr series, an open-weights chat model fine-tuned from Mistral AI's Mistral 7B and released in October 2023. stripedhyenanous7b: StripedHyena Nous 7B is an open-weights chat model from Together AI, developed in collaboration with Nous Research and released in December 2023. codellama70b: Code Llama 70B Instruct is the largest Code Llama model from Meta, released in January 2024 as a later addition to the code-specialised family built on Llama 2. gemma112bit: Gemma 1.1 2B IT is Google's April 2024 update to Gemma 2B IT, the smallest instruction-tuned model in the first Gemma generation of open-weights models. vicuna7b: Vicuna 7B is the smallest Vicuna chat model from LMSYS, an open-weights model created by fine-tuning a 7-billion-parameter Meta Llama model on user-shared ChatGPT conversations collected from ShareGPT. smollm217b: SmolLM2 1.7B Instruct is the largest model in Hugging Face's SmolLM2 family of compact open-weights language models, released in late 2024 alongside 135M and 360M versions. llama321b: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct is the smallest model in Meta's Llama 3.2 family, a 1-billion-parameter open-weights text model released in September 2024 alongside the 3B version. mistral7b: Mistral 7B Instruct is the instruction-tuned version of Mistral 7B, the first model released by Paris-based Mistral AI, in September 2023. llama27b: Llama 2 7B Chat is the smallest dialogue model in Meta's Llama 2 family, released in July 2023 alongside 13B and 70B versions. gemma2bit: Gemma 2B IT is the smallest instruction-tuned model in Google's first Gemma family of open-weights models, released in February 2024. qwen154b: Qwen1.5-4B-Chat is a small chat model in Alibaba's Qwen1.5 series, released in February 2024 as a beta version of what became Qwen2. olmo7b: OLMo 7B Instruct is an open chat model from the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2), the instruction-tuned version of OLMo 7B from the first OLMo release in early 2024. koala13b: Koala 13B is a research chat model from the Berkeley Artificial Intelligence Research (BAIR) lab, released in April 2023. alpaca13b: Alpaca 13B is an instruction-following research model that applies Stanford's Alpaca recipe, introduced in March 2023, to Meta's original 13-billion-parameter LLaMA model. gpt4all13bsnoozy: GPT4All 13B Snoozy is an open-weights chat model from Nomic AI, fine-tuned from Meta's original LLaMA 13B on the GPT4All dataset of assistant-style prompts and responses generated with OpenAI's GPT-3.5-Turbo. mpt7b: MPT 7B Chat is the chat-tuned version of MPT-7B, the first model in MosaicML's MPT (MosaicML Pretrained Transformer) series, released in May 2023; MosaicML is now part of Databricks. chatglm36b: ChatGLM3 6B is a bilingual Chinese-English open-weights chat model from Zhipu AI (now Z.ai) and Tsinghua University's KEG lab, released in October 2023 as the third generation of the ChatGLM-6B line. rwkv4raven14b: RWKV-4 Raven 14B is an open-weights chat model from BlinkDL, the handle of RWKV creator Bo Peng, built on the RWKV-4 architecture. chatglm26b: ChatGLM2 6B is the second-generation bilingual Chinese-English chat model from Zhipu AI (now Z.ai) and Tsinghua University's KEG lab, released in June 2023. openassistantpythia12b: OpenAssistant Pythia 12B is an open-weights chat model from the LAION-led OpenAssistant project, fine-tuned from EleutherAI's Pythia 12B and released in April 2023. chatglm6b: ChatGLM 6B is the original bilingual Chinese-English chat model from Zhipu AI (now Z.ai) and Tsinghua University's KEG lab, released in March 2023. fastchatt53b: FastChat-T5 3B is an open-weights chat model from LMSYS, fine-tuned from Google's Flan-T5-XL on user-shared ChatGPT conversations collected from ShareGPT and released in April 2023. dolly2012b: Dolly 2.0 12B is an instruction-following open-weights model from Databricks, released in April 2023 and fine-tuned from EleutherAI's Pythia 12B. llama13b: LLaMA 13B is a 13-billion-parameter base model from Meta's original LLaMA family, released in February 2023 in 7B, 13B, 33B and 65B sizes. stablelmtunedalpha7b: StableLM Tuned Alpha 7B is an early open-weights chat model from Stability AI: the instruction-tuned version of its 7-billion-parameter StableLM-Alpha base model, released in April 2023. claudefable52: Claude Fable 5.2 is Anthropic's flagship Claude model, released in November 2026. museglimmer30b: Muse Glimmer 30B is a dense 30B-parameter open-weights multimodal model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, distilled from Muse Spark and released in August 2026.
